title: Branding/UX directive: 20-0 presentation, homepage copy, player browser pagination, clickable header

evidence.result: 7 UI changes documented for V23 only: (1) 'Set Up Your Draft' → 'DRAFT' with heavy UI emphasis, new subtitle

; (2) '32 real NFL franchises...' → 'Draft, Season, Playoffs, Super Bowl. Can you go 20-0?'; (3) 'Play the season. Seventeen games...' → 'Play the season. Season, Playoffs, Super Bowl. Can you go 20-0?'; (4) Player browser: 15 names visible before header access; (5) Header must be clickable → homepage; (6) Consistent header across all pages; (7) All text changes emphasized '20-0'.
